news_risk: No sanctions or regulatory action found. No criminal cases against the company or its owners found in the sources checked. Per project rules these are noted neutrally and are not rejection grounds.
rf_supply: No public evidence found of supplies to Russia or CIS. Company site describes operations in India and UAE only (2 countries, 25.1 MTPA). No customs/B-L or contract record located. Status: not confirmed.
